at_sea:
TIER 1 OF THE BUILD QUEUE, ticket by ticket under Akien's standing method 'run the tier, report at the tier boundary'. 9579a6f9cec6 (a-device-reaches-trouble-over-the-bus-never-by-import) is PROVED at all five seam ends and pushed. Its tail was a 93-proof re-seal sweep that surfaced 5 reds; ALL FIVE ARE NOW DISPOSED BY FIXING, none by narrowing a check (commit c9db255, pushed):
(1) the saveslate door had a SECOND live path — the generic `skill_block fire saveslate` CLI, which routes to door.main() because the door sets COMPOSING_DOOR. It reached the live boundary from inside a proof and auto-committed 14 files of another voyage's in-flight work (commit b5423c2, pushed to origin/main before it was noticed). Fixed with CAIRN_SAVESLATE_SLATES_DIR; the proof now asserts both repo HEADs unmoved across every fixture fire. 33 teeth, sealed netns green.
(2) the ground loop NEVER honoured SIGTERM within a cadence: PEP 475 makes time.sleep RETRY after a handler returns, recomputing from the original deadline, so a bool flag could not shorten the wait it interrupted. threading.Event.wait fixes it. New proof test_stop_is_prompt.py — 0.06s green, mutation back to time.sleep reds at 59.00s. Sealed netns.
(3)(4)(5) three proofs were reading RED FOR THE WRONG REASON — a pty clear-screen escape eating the CGROUP key (which also un-hollowed a tooth comparing <none> to <none>); a hardcoded 60s beats-window that turned a CONTINUATION claim into a LATENCY one (measured 87.3s/cycle = 60s cadence + 23.7s beat); and a liveness address left behind when ground_loop became a MACHINE of the cairn device.
NEW COMPONENT, born out of a red rather than a plan: cairn/tools/cgroup. Arm 6 of the launcher proof censuses python reads of /proc/<pid>/cgroup and allows one; re-run for the first time since 6ae83e7 it counted THREE — two later voyages (4d96964532c2, a6cf55a6dd6d) had each grown a copy, and two of the three had lost the ' (deleted)' handling so a killed caller's scope compared unequal to itself. Two devices needing one primitive is a TOOL (Law 6). Charter + proof written, sealed netns, inspector clean.
next_direction: SAIL THE REST OF TIER 1, in this order, one /sail per ticket with /saveslate + /compact between: 1c4ae8f053fe (a-seal-snapshots-cairn-once-per-batch, BUILDME:waiting), d0f2b03952e3 (hollow-is-measured, BUILDME:waiting), 4d9115eb04cd (a-seal-that-cannot-be-reproven-rides-the-ruled-ladder, BUILDME:waiting), 8754ae677af6 (codemother-crosses-a-boat-through-the-harbor-door, BUILDME:waiting), feeb4c786b14 (proof-coverage-is-declared, PROVEME:waiting — closest to done), 1accdc1781aa (a-green-seal-crosses-the-boat-it-proves, BUILDME:queued). Then tiers 2-4. Report to Akien at the TIER boundary, not before, unless something needs a ruling — nothing does yet.
